A '''pale-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="BH" />

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they possessed [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] features, large builds, with [[Color/Legends|pale]] skin, solid blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a lack of visible [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="BH" />

==Species in the galaxy==
One member of this species served as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] among the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]]<ref name="BH" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'' is set immediately after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared<ref name="BH" /> in the [[2002]]<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> video game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''.<ref name="BH" />
